title: 第2415章 灵绝寒海第2414章 任务前夕
content_zh:
“江某实力有限，一切听从各位的安排。”
江平安把自己的姿态摆得很低，以免引起这群天才的不满。
其他人在看到他这副谦逊的样子，心中的不满少了很多。
就怕那种实力不行，又很狂傲的人加入队伍，这种人很可能会拖累大家。
岳天擎张开嘴，雄浑的声音响起。
“既然人齐了，有些事情要提前交代一下。”
“这次执行任务，由我岳天擎和苏锦道友共同领军，你们要服从我们的命令，不可擅自行动。”
“我们此次的任务，就是进入遗迹，搜寻里面的资源，特别是始源天龙的骸骨。”
“据前两队传回来的消息，遗迹内部危险不多，但是，并不代表安全。”
“耀光神殿那群狗东西肯定会伏击我们，另外两个神殿也不是什么好鸟，时刻做好血战的准备。”
岳天擎应该是想要做战前动员，只不过他似乎并不擅长这方面，调不动大家的情绪。
苏锦张开红唇，发出好听的声音。
“我们在遗迹内找到的物资，卖给神殿后会拿到同等价值的资源，这些奖励大家平分。”
“资源很重要，但是大家的性命更加重要，我希望大家团结互助，一切以生命为主，让我们每一个人都能安全地从遗迹中走出来。”
苏锦的话显然更有感染力，她从资源和安全方面给了大家保证。
外加精神秘术影响，众人内心都对她产生了信任。
“如若大家都已经做好准备，我们现在就出发！”
“是！”
在苏锦和岳天擎的带领下，众人前往圣地内的传送阵，传送至灵绝寒海。
灵绝寒海并不在圣地内，而在圣地外的边缘。

说是边缘，但是一个主神想要飞过去的话，都需要花费很长时间。
灵绝寒海的面积甚至比融合了数个神界的神墟圣地还要大，里面冰冻了数不清的星辰。
从远处看，灵绝寒海就像一个白色托盘，拖住了神墟圣地。
发现始源天龙遗迹的地方，在灵绝寒海下面的一个封层之中。
那里原本没有什么人，但由于始源天龙遗迹的发现，圣地在附近建造了一个大型传送阵。
这种远距离传送阵开启一次并不便宜，幸好这次任务是灵衍神殿买单，并不需要他们支付费用。
刚传送过来，江平安就感觉周围散发着寒气。
这点温度对他并没有影响。
真正让他感到压力的是，没了圣地的庇护，残酷的一面将展现出来。
他收敛气息，隐藏在人群后面，当个路人甲，不引人注意。
他们现在位于冰层之中。
content_en:
"Jiang's strength is limited, and everything will be subject to your arrangements."
Jiang Ping'an kept his posture very low to avoid causing dissatisfaction among these geniuses.
Seeing his humble look, others felt much less dissatisfied.
I am afraid that a person who is not strong enough and is very arrogant will join the team. Such a person is likely to drag everyone down.
Yue Tianqing opened his mouth and a powerful voice sounded.
"Now that everyone is here, there are some things that need to be explained in advance."
"This mission will be jointly led by me, Yue Tianqing, and fellow Taoist Su Jin. You must obey our orders and not act without authorization."
"Our mission this time is to enter the ruins and search for the resources inside, especially the bones of the Siyuan Tianlong."
"According to the news from the first two teams, there are not many dangers inside the ruins, but it does not mean that it is safe."
"Those idiots from the Yaoguang Temple will definitely ambush us. The other two temples are not good birds either. Always be prepared for a bloody battle."
Yue Tianqing probably wanted to mobilize before the war, but he didn't seem to be good at it and couldn't arouse everyone's emotions.
Su Jin opened her red lips and made a nice sound.
"After selling the materials we find in the ruins to the temple, we will receive resources of equal value. We will share these rewards equally."
"Resources are important, but everyone's lives are more important. I hope that everyone will unite and help each other, and put life first, so that each of us can come out of the ruins safely."
Su Jin's words were obviously more contagious. She gave everyone assurance in terms of resources and safety.
Coupled with the influence of spiritual magic, everyone trusts her in their hearts.
"If everyone is ready, we will set off now!"
"Yes!"
Under the leadership of Su Jin and Yue Tianqing, everyone went to the teleportation array in the holy land and teleported to the Lingjuehan Sea.
The Lingjue Hanhai is not within the Holy Land, but on the edge outside the Holy Land.
It is said to be on the edge, but if a main god wants to fly over, it will take a long time.
The area of ​​Lingjue Hanhai is even larger than the Shenxu Holy Land, which combines several divine realms, and countless stars are frozen in it.
Viewed from a distance, Lingjue Hanhai looks like a white tray, dragging down the Holy Land of Shenxu.
The place where the remains of the Origin of Heavenly Dragon were discovered is in a seal beneath the Lingjue Cold Sea.
There were originally no people there, but due to the discovery of the Shiyuan Tianlong ruins, the Holy Land built a large teleportation array nearby.
It is not cheap to activate this kind of long-distance teleportation array once. Fortunately, this mission is paid for by Lingyan Temple and they do not need to pay any fees.
As soon as he was teleported, Jiang Ping'an felt a cold air emanating from his surroundings.
The temperature had no effect on him.
What really puts him under pressure is that without the protection of the Holy Land, his cruel side will be revealed.
He restrained his aura and hid behind the crowd, acting as a passerby and not attracting attention.
They are now in the ice.
